critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1145 lines. PLANS dict + TIER_DAILY_LIMITS for plus tier are clean, but recommend extracting plans/payments into routers/payments.py.

/api/analyses/quota only returns the free-tier limit when user.tier!='coach' — but a 'plus' tier user (limit 3) would currently fall into the 'free' branch and report limit=1. Consider extending get_quota to use TIER_DAILY_LIMITS[user.tier] so plus users see remaining out of 3, not 1. Same goes for the free-tier enforcement at L511–522 in create_analysis (always uses FREE_DAILY_LIMIT regardless of plus tier).

Plus-tier daily-limit enforcement is NOT yet wired into POST /api/analyses — code only allows unlimited for tier=='coach' and otherwise applies FREE_DAILY_LIMIT=1. Once a user upgrades to Plus, they will still be capped at 1/day instead of 3. (No test exists yet because there is no demo Plus user, but this should be patched alongside the v1.3 frontend.)

_apply_subscription_if_paid hard-codes tier='coach' on payment success — Plus-tier purchases will INCORRECTLY upgrade the user to coach unlimited, not to plus tier with 3/day. CRITICAL bug for Plus billing once a real customer pays $9.99.
